name: dxdb-demo
description: dxdb browser conformance harness: runs the storage conformance suite in Chromium, Firefox and WebKit

scripts.test: npm run build:wasm && npm run typecheck && playwright test
scripts.test:chromium: npm run build:wasm && npm run typecheck && playwright test --project=chromium
scripts.test:firefox: npm run build:wasm && npm run typecheck && playwright test --project=firefox
scripts.test:webkit: npm run build:wasm && npm run typecheck && playwright test --project=webkit
